S67+D101.action: I slide the cancellation notice up the duty chart.
S67+D101.line: You outrank me. You announce the cancellation; I will take the minutes.

S67+D101.action: I put my name under secretary, leaving chair blank.
S67+D101.line: The chair begins the difficult conversation. I have already volunteered to be secretary.

S67+D101.action: I draw an arrow back to your approval signature.
S67+D101.line: You authorized the project. Surely the news that it failed has to originate from your office.
S67+D101.tactic: Return the task to its authorizer

S124+D14.action: I pull my chair toward the locked folder and away from my own envelope.
S124+D14.line: Give me the insider briefing first. My envelope is only visitor paperwork.

S124+D14.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown over the incriminating note.
S124+D14.line: Why am I still getting the public version? My signature can wait until I am properly included.

S22+D14.action: I turn the damaged photograph facedown and open the catering bill.
S22+D14.line: Before we discuss the photograph, who is paying for the extra meals?

S22+D14.action: I slide my incriminating note under a repair schedule.
S22+D14.line: Yes, the cupboard talks. Does it need servicing before we discuss who switched it on?
S22+D14.tactic: Maintain the unusual premise while redirecting

S22+D14.action: I draw an exit route over the awkward question on my notepad.
S22+D14.line: We can talk about my missing hour once we know this floating room has a fire escape.

S192+D74.action: I place an apology form between our unfinished cups.
S192+D74.line: Before either of us leaves, initial here to confirm we are still friends.

S192+D74.action: I put my coat beside a blank closure certificate.
S192+D74.line: The apology is recorded. We still need a definition of okay before I can close the meeting.

S192+D74.action: I write our names beneath a rule headed future visits.
S192+D74.line: We cannot end this conversation with next time undefined. Which Tuesday makes us an actual policy?
S192+D74.tactic: Turn repair into an ongoing agreement

S01+D13.action: I hide my glue-stained thumb behind an investigation clipboard.
S01+D13.line: I will lead the inquiry. Start with the windows; nobody needs to examine my desk yet.
S01+D13.tactic: Direct the investigation away from yourself

S01+D13.action: I place my broken screwdriver inside the evidence box and close it.
S01+D13.line: All evidence comes through me. My first ruling is that this box stays sealed until lunch.
S01+D13.tactic: Control access to the revealing evidence

S01+D13.action: I wipe my muddy footprint while issuing assignments.
S01+D13.line: You check outside. I will supervise the floor, since somebody clearly neglected it.

S114+D97.action: I pass you one unopened letter but keep hold of the others.
S114+D97.line: Read this one for me. It is a division of labour, not a rescue.
S114+D97.tactic: Frame needed support as equal work

S114+D97.action: I offer my difficult call list with a pencil.
S114+D97.line: Take the first call while I prepare the second. Please do not congratulate me for asking.

S124+D101.action: I pull up a chair beside the sealed announcement.
S124+D101.line: If I belong in this meeting, read me the difficult part first. I should not have to hear it secondhand.

S124+D101.action: I place my badge on the unopened letter.
S124+D101.line: You have the clearance to say what is in here. Include me by saying it, not by making me open it alone.
S124+D101.tactic: Link initiation to who speaks first

S124+D13.action: I place my badge over the key I used to open the cabinet.
S124+D13.line: Give me the full report, not the visitor summary. I should be inside this investigation, not on its suspect list.
S124+D13.tactic: Claim insider status to manage suspicion

S124+D13.action: I volunteer my notes but leave out the page with my signature.
S124+D13.line: As one of the trusted people, I can organize the confidential evidence. Start by giving me every copy.
S124+D13.tactic: Collect dangerous information as an insider

S192+D101.action: I draw a speaking-order box above the difficult announcement.
S192+D101.line: The policy needs an opening statement from you. I can only document the bad news once you have said it.

S192+D101.action: I offer a form marked emotional agenda item one.
S192+D101.line: Please introduce the sensitive subject officially. I am not authorized to open an unannounced item.

S67+D74.action: I keep our coats beside the unsigned reconciliation form.
S67+D74.line: I can accept an apology, but only you can authorize us being okay. We cannot close this level yet.

S67+D74.action: I move the goodbye card back up the chart.
S67+D74.line: Departure needs clearance from the person still upset. That appears to be me, and I need another minute.
S67+D74.tactic: Locate authority in the unresolved feeling

S22+D101.action: I check the telephone battery before handing it over.
S22+D101.line: The charge will last the difficult call. You start with the bad news; I will write down the practical next steps.

S22+D101.action: I arrange tissues and water beside the announcement.
S22+D101.line: Everything is ready for the conversation. You say the frightening first sentence; I will keep the kettle on.
S22+D101.tactic: Prepare everything except the first words

S15+D04.action: I stand in front of the replacement chair I already removed.
S15+D04.line: Agree that we only need one person at this desk. I have saved us the cost of assembling that second chair.
S15+D04.tactic: Present defensive action as an approved saving

S15+D04.action: I hold a revised roster with my name on every shift.
S15+D04.line: Tell me the extra coverage was sensible. There is no space left for a replacement this month anyway.

S19+D03.action: I set an apology card between three carefully aligned spoons.
S19+D03.line: The next part begins with two words. We both know which two, so I will wait for the proper opening.
S19+D03.tactic: Let ritual invite an unnamed apology

S19+D03.action: I turn the ceremonial cup so its crack faces you.
S19+D03.line: Before the third turn, tradition leaves space for regret. Would you like to fill that space?

S21+D21.action: I raise a toast over the extra mess with a tight smile.
S21+D21.line: Another spill! What a glorious opportunity for me to clean while you enjoy yourself.

S21+D21.action: I clap for the delay and tear my spare schedule in half.
S21+D21.line: Wonderful, more time together. Every minute I needed elsewhere is becoming a gift to you.

S11+D16.action: I keep my confession closed but move my chair beside yours.
S11+D16.line: You are the only person I can tell. Start with your mistake so I know I can survive saying mine.
S11+D16.tactic: Depend on a trusted first confession

S11+D16.action: I slide you an empty page and keep my own folded.
S11+D16.line: I would not ask anyone else. Write your part first; I need your honesty to get mine open.

S53+D60.action: I place the key in my successor’s hand, then touch it again.
S53+D60.line: Your first act as leader can be naming me adviser with final approval. Say it clearly for everyone.
S53+D60.tactic: Transfer power while reclaiming its last word

S53+D60.action: I turn the new leader’s chair toward my old desk.
S53+D60.line: You are ready to lead. Begin by announcing which decisions still need my signature.

S40+D05.action: I present the complete packed picnic bag with its handles facing you.
S40+D05.line: Everything is ready. Would you like the honour of carrying the perfectly prepared bag?
S40+D05.tactic: Make preparation a way to transfer work

S40+D05.action: I place the labelled supplies on the garden cart.
S40+D05.line: I packed precisely for your talents. You can volunteer to pull it, and none of my planning goes to waste.
S40+D05.tactic: Cast the unwanted task as a fit for care

S24+D06.action: I add your pause to my map of coincidences.
S24+D06.line: Interesting timing. Which part of the larger plan did you hear about before I arrived?

S24+D06.action: I draw a line between two apparently unrelated names.
S24+D06.line: Those two connect, obviously. Tell me where you last heard them mentioned together.
S24+D06.tactic: Let a claimed connection extract information

S91+D26.action: I bring our shared dessert back as the coats come out.
S91+D26.line: We have not done the two-spoon part yet. Then we can find where the spoons belong.

S91+D26.action: I start our old handshake and leave my hand raised.
S91+D26.line: You know there is a last part. Give me a second; I am remembering the part after that.

S118+D14.action: I place a glass of water on the letter I do not want discussed.
S118+D14.line: The letter can wait. Do you need water, space, or a short walk right now?

S118+D14.action: I fetch a cushion before the conversation reaches my departure.
S118+D14.line: Before why I left, let us sort out where you can sit comfortably for this.

S147+D149.action: I measure the invisible shelf with technical seriousness.
S147+D149.line: You handle the negative depth. I will do the ordinary screws, which require less specialized courage.
S147+D149.tactic: Use invented expertise to delegate impossibility

S147+D149.action: I mark one section of the diagram anti-gravity load.
S147+D149.line: That is your component. I am assigning you the impossible part under its proper technical name.
S147+D149.tactic: Make the impossible task sound precisely assignable

S165+D165.action: I toast the floating table, then snatch a coaster beneath a cup.
S165+D165.line: Levitation is a breakthrough. Wet rings on the ceiling are completely unacceptable.
S165+D165.tactic: Keep impossible delight and ordinary alarm together

S165+D165.action: I welcome the invisible guest and inspect the crumbs.
S165+D165.line: Wonderful, a guest without spatial limits. Shoes off; the carpet still has standards.
S165+D165.tactic: Celebrate the premise, ground the concern

S183+D176.action: I hold a permission form for an exception I have not dared request.
S183+D176.line: Could you bend the rule first and give me the reference number? Then I can comply with the precedent.
S183+D176.tactic: Seek safe permission to break a rule

S183+D176.action: I point to a blank exception field with a shaking pen.
S183+D176.line: Demonstrate the allowed breach once. I need something correct to copy before I risk it.
S183+D176.tactic: Make another person establish the safe example

S214+D195.action: I put my losing score beside the extra fee.
S214+D195.line: Your rule cost me the entry and the transport. Apologize for that unequal start, not for my disappointment.

S214+D195.action: I turn the prize over and show my bill beneath it.
S214+D195.line: Who got the benefit, and who paid twice? Acknowledge that before calling this fair.
S214+D195.tactic: Compare benefit and cost to seek acknowledgment

S223+D219.action: I put the old picnic photo beside your apology.
S223+D219.line: Yes, the missed lunch hurt. Now look at who packed for two; the promise is the part we have not repaired.
S223+D219.tactic: Reinterpret a memory to deepen an apology

S223+D219.action: I turn the same photograph toward the empty chair.
S223+D219.line: I accept that you forgot. What I need next is an apology for calling my waiting funny.
S223+D219.tactic: Change what the old scene means

S240+D230.action: I repeat our opening greeting with a colder smile.
S240+D230.line: Make yourself at home. I am still answering whether you are welcome, not why I changed the locks.
S240+D230.tactic: Return a safer phrase with new meaning

S240+D230.action: I offer the same cup again, more gently.
S240+D230.line: Tea? I would rather answer that first kind question than the one about why I disappeared.
S240+D230.tactic: Use a changed callback as evasion

S29+D38.action: I fold the abandoned cleanup list into a perfect paper boat.
S29+D38.line: Before we assign blame for the mess, watch this crease. Everyone does it wrong.

S29+D38.action: I inspect one spotless spoon above the mountain of dirty plates.
S29+D38.line: We will discuss the cleanup later. First, let me teach you what a properly dried spoon sounds like.
S29+D38.tactic: Make the minor detail a teaching demonstration

S53+D86.action: I give you our old meeting key, then check your grip.
S53+D86.line: You should run things now. Never mind why I stopped coming; show me how you will open up.
S53+D86.tactic: Mentor the successor instead of addressing the rupture

S53+D86.action: I move my name below yours on our old rota.
S53+D86.line: Let us call this succession, not estrangement. I will supervise your first week; how we got here can wait.
S53+D86.tactic: Reframe the break as a supervised handover

S139+D201.action: I tap our signal and point to the unsigned thank-you note.
S139+D201.line: Use the code names, but tell the inner circle whose plan actually got us through.
S139+D201.tactic: Ask for recognition through approved secret language

S139+D201.action: I hold the sealed report against my chest.
S139+D201.line: I need my contribution acknowledged in the approved phrase before I can release this to the group.
S139+D201.tactic: Make credit part of the disclosure protocol

S164+D123.action: I trace a widening crack across the edited account.
S164+D123.line: Your missing truth is taking the table with it. Apologize for the omission before we lose another leg.
S164+D123.tactic: Treat concealment as a literal structural threat

S164+D123.action: I prop up a drooping photograph with the hidden letter.
S164+D123.line: The explanation can wait. Acknowledge you hid it; I am trying to keep yesterday from falling out of the frame.
S164+D123.tactic: Ask for acknowledgment as reality repair

S173+D47.action: I place one stamped page atop the untouched stack.
S173+D47.line: You asked for a completed form. This one. Three rejected applications taught me never to volunteer extra paperwork.
S173+D47.tactic: Use experienced caution to justify narrow compliance

S173+D47.action: I pull my chair precisely to the meeting-room threshold.
S173+D47.line: The notice says report to the door. Last time I went further, they made me secretary.
S173+D47.tactic: A remembered trap motivates literal compliance

S224+D102.action: I push your returned gift back across the table.
S224+D102.line: Now I owe you an explanation for refusing it. Tell me the missing part so I can give the right explanation.
S224+D102.tactic: An apparent favour reverses the information debt

S224+D102.action: I write my name beneath yours on the IOU.
S224+D102.line: Every reassuring phrase adds another favour. Tell me the awkward part before I owe you twice.
S224+D102.tactic: Treat withheld information as a new favour to repay
